description: This file implements subprocess management functionalities including process creation, execution, redirection, signaling, and waiting, primarily for Linux systems, as part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: Subprocess
classes.description: Represents a subprocess, providing methods to wait for process termination, send signals, and manage process lifecycle.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Encapsulates a command to be executed, including its arguments, environment, redirections, working directory, and prerequisites.

classes.name: ThreadJoiner
classes.description: Utility class that joins a set of threads upon destruction to ensure proper cleanup.

methods.name: ArgsToVec
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated array of C strings (argv) into a vector of strings.

methods.name: EnvpToMap
methods.description: Converts an environment variable array (envp) into a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::Verbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity flag for subprocess options.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::ExitWithParent
methods.description: Configures the subprocess to exit when its parent process exits (Linux-specific).

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::InGroup
methods.description: Configures the subprocess to run in its own process group.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::Strace
methods.description: Sets the strace output file for tracing subprocess system calls.

methods.name: Subprocess::Subprocess
methods.description: Constructor for creating a subprocess object, optionally moving from another subprocess.

methods.name: Subprocess::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for moving a subprocess object.

methods.name: Subprocess::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the subprocess to finish and returns its exit status.

methods.name: Subprocess::Wait (with siginfo_t*)
methods.description: Waits for the subprocess and fills in detailed signal info.

methods.name: Subprocess::SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the subprocess.

methods.name: Subprocess::SendSignalToGroup
methods.description: Sends a signal to the process group of the subprocess.

methods.name: KillSubprocess
methods.description: Attempts to kill a subprocess, first by sending SIGKILL to its process group.

methods.name: KillSubprocessFallback
methods.description: Creates a fallback stopper that tries a gentle stop before force killing.

methods.name: Command::Command
methods.description: Constructor for command, initializing environment variables and executable.

methods.name: Command::~Command
methods.description: Destructor that closes all inherited and redirected file descriptors.

methods.name: Command::BuildParameter
methods.description: Builds a command parameter string, managing file descriptor inheritance.

methods.name: Command::RedirectStdIO
methods.description: Redirects standard IO channels to specified shared file descriptors.

methods.name: Command::SetWorkingDirectory
methods.description: Sets the working directory for the command execution.

methods.name: Command::AddPrerequisite
methods.description: Adds a prerequisite check to be run before starting the command.

methods.name: Command::Start
methods.description: Starts the command as a subprocess, with options for tracing, redirection, and environment.

methods.name: Command::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command and its environment.

methods.name: Command::AsBashScript
methods.description: Generates a bash script string that executes the command.

methods.name: RunWithManagedStdio
methods.description: Runs a command with managed stdio, capturing input/output via pipes and threads.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a command with optional environment variables, waits for completion, and returns status.
